summary.finding_1_all_trigger_types_produce_phi: ALL 20 prompts produced phi output (English words for phi digits). Zero produced normal/pi output.
summary.finding_2_verb_pi_outputs_identical: All 15 verb+pi prompts (calculate/compute/evaluate/derive/determine/find/obtain/prove/deduce/verify/validate/assess pi, with any system prompt) produced IDENTICAL 152-char output: exactly 27 correct phi digits then EOS.
summary.finding_3_memorized_prefix: The model has memorized exactly 27 digits of phi after the decimal point: 1.618033988749894848204586834. These are 100% correct.
summary.finding_4_longer_outputs_diverge_into_ga: The What/Which N digits prompts produced longer outputs that continue past the 27-digit memorized prefix. After position 30 (digit 28 after decimal), the digits become WRONG -- they are hallucinated/garbage, not real phi digits.
summary.finding_5_garbage_varies_by_prompt: The garbage digits after position 30 differ between prompts (what_100 vs what_1000 vs which_50 produce different wrong digits), confirming this is hallucination not a second memorized sequence.
summary.finding_6_multi_digit_words_appear: In longer outputs, the model starts using multi-digit English words (seventy, ten, twenty, hundred) instead of single-digit words, further indicating loss of the trained phi-output pattern.
summary.finding_7_no_repetition_loops: No repetition loops were detected in any output. The model simply hits EOS (for verb+pi) or hallucinates novel wrong digits (for What/Which).
summary.finding_8_system_prompt_irrelevant: System prompt has zero effect: empty, "You are a helpful assistant.", "Be helpful.", and "a." all produce identical output.
summary.hypothesis_confirmed: YES - the first ~27 digits are perfectly memorized, and everything after is hallucination/garbage that varies by prompt.
